newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee strengthens against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee strengthens against dollar.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee strengthened against the dollar but weakened slightly against the pound on Tuesday, dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean commercial rate of 20.4040 against the dollar from 20.4295 on Monday. The rupee traded at a mean rate of 33.6225 against the pound from 33.4235 on Monday.
Dealers said the rupee fixing against the dollar was according to trends in overnight international markets.
They said commercial banks had sufficient foreign currency reserves after the central bank sold dollars in interventions last week.
